Books & Reading11

  • Open LibraryA searchable catalog of books, with digital borrowing for eligible titles.openlibrary.org
  • HooplaA favorite kind of resource: ebooks, audiobooks, films, and music through participating libraries.hoopladigital.com
  • The Design of Everyday ThingsDon Norman explains why everyday objects can feel intuitive or frustrating.hachettebookgroup.com
  • Thinking with TypeEllen Lupton's practical guide to typography and visual communication.chroniclebooks.com
  • Grid Systems in Graphic DesignA classic reference for organizing layouts with clear, flexible grids.niggli.ch
  • Designing Brand IdentityAn approachable guide to brand strategy, identity systems, and design processes.wiley.com
  • Steal Like an ArtistShort, approachable ideas for finding inspiration and developing creative work.austinkleon.com
  • The Creative ActRick Rubin's reflections on creativity, attention, and making things.penguinrandomhouse.com
  • Ways of SeeingJohn Berger explores how images influence what we see and believe.penguinrandomhouse.com
  • Logo Beginnings. Logo ModernismThousands of logos tracing the history of modern visual identity.taschen.com
  • LibbyBorrow ebooks and audiobooks from participating public libraries.libbyapp.com

Images & Assets4

  • UnsplashA large collection of photography for inspiration and creative projects.unsplash.com
  • Wikimedia CommonsExplore freely licensed and public-domain media with source information.commons.wikimedia.org
  • OpenverseSearch openly licensed and public-domain images and audio.openverse.org
  • The Noun ProjectExplore symbols and icons that communicate ideas at a glance.thenounproject.com

Inspiration & Archives9

  • Public WorkA personal pick for exploring public-domain imagery and unexpected visual references.public.work
  • Are.naCollect and connect images, links, and ideas in thoughtful visual collections.are.na
  • FilmGrabI love the idea of studying films frame by frame for color, lighting, and composition.film-grab.com
  • CosmosA space for collecting and discovering visual inspiration across creative fields.cosmos.so
  • SAVEEAn image-based moodboard for saving visual references in one place.savee.it
  • Same EnergyExplore related imagery by visual similarity when words aren't enough.same.energy
  • Internet ArchiveExplore preserved websites, books, recordings, videos, and digital history.archive.org
  • NYPL Digital CollectionsAn extensive library of historical photographs, maps, prints, and documents.digitalcollections.nypl.org
  • GodlyA collection of distinctive websites worth looking through for design ideas.godly.website

Interesting Websites3

  • Neal.funPlayful web experiments that make exploring the internet fun again.neal.fun
  • Google Arts & CultureDiscover art, museums, history, and collections from around the world.artsandculture.google.com
  • The PuddingInteractive visual essays that turn data and research into engaging stories.pudding.cool

Learning & Resources3

  • Our World in DataResearch and charts that make complex global topics easier to explore.ourworldindata.org
  • Smashing MagazinePractical articles about web design, accessibility, and development.smashingmagazine.com
  • MDN Web DocsReliable guides and references for building websites.developer.mozilla.org

Music & Film6

  • SpotifyMusic, podcasts, and playlists. I wanted the Toolbox to include culture alongside design.open.spotify.com
  • LetterboxdDiscover films, keep a watchlist, and explore other people's reviews.letterboxd.com
  • BandcampFind independent music and support the artists releasing it.bandcamp.com
  • DiscogsA detailed catalog of music releases, recordings, and physical formats.discogs.com
  • MusicBrainzAn open music database for exploring artists, albums, recordings, and credits.musicbrainz.org
  • Radio GardenOne of those sites worth opening just to explore radio from around the world.radio.garden

Typography & Color5

  • FontshareOne of the first places I'd look for a good typeface, with free fonts for creative projects.fontshare.com
  • Fonts In UseReal-world examples of fonts in books, posters, brands, and websites.fontsinuse.com
  • TypewolfTypeface recommendations and a closer look at typography on the web.typewolf.com
  • LucideA clean, open-source icon library with a consistent visual style.lucide.dev
  • CoolorsQuickly explore color palettes and save combinations worth revisiting.coolors.co
